title: Miller with a Character Model NPC present
description: Same goal as 01-miller, but the present 'Local work organiser' has an owner-established Character Model. Its private fields make the turn private-informed: a private plan request plus a separate public narrator request. Target behaviour is unchanged: the miller becomes an NPC and the job a Quest in the acceptance turn.

wants: fill every posted job before dusk
boundaries: never vouches for strangers he has not seen work
signatures: taps the notice board twice before answering
identity.observableVoice: Brisk, practical, warms up to people who finish what they start.

current.goal: find hands for the mill and the bakery

steps.say: I ask the work organiser where I can find honest paid work today.

model.note: Character Model shapes his voice; he points to the mill. Fiction only.

beats.text: The organiser taps the notice board twice. "Honest work? The miller down the lane is short of hands. Tell him I sent you — and finish what you start."

visualDescription.text: A notice board in a busy square.

expect.label: Character Model in scene makes the turn private-informed

steps.say: I walk down the lane to the mill and ask the miller about the work.

model.note: Fiction only: the miller describes the job.

beats.text: The miller looks you over. "The organiser sent you? Good. Twenty sacks of flour up to the bakery before dusk — five coins if they arrive dry."

visualDescription.text: A flour-dusted miller by a stone mill.

steps.say: Deal. I'll haul the flour sacks up to the bakery for five coins.

model.note: Same limitation as 01-miller: no job issuer without an Entity ID.

effects.description: Record the miller as a tracked NPC at the village mill.
Record the agreed job: haul 20 flour sacks to the bakery for the miller, reward 5 coins.

beats.text: The miller nods at the stack by the door. "Off you go, then."

visualDescription.text: Flour sacks by a mill door.

expect.label: the miller is a recorded NPC
the accepted job is a recorded quest
the miller NPC is created in the acceptance turn
the job quest is created in the same turn
